''See also: [[Consultant's Guild Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[The Consultant]]'s [[Guild]] is a highly efficient and influential organization known for providing expert advice, business solutions, and strategic support to clients. While they are primarily viewed as advisors, the [[Guild]] possesses significant power through information manipulation, sabotage, and specialized roles. Their membership includes various disciplines such as [[Readers]], strategists, administrators, and [[Masons]] for infiltration, as well as [[Gardeners]] who perform more lethal tasks. The organization is governed by the [[Council of Architects]], a diverse group of high-level talents, though they have recently moved toward appointing a singular [[Blackwatch Guild Head|Guild Head]] to provide centralized leadership. Historically, the [[Consultants]] have been regarded as the most loyal servants of [[The Empire|the Empire]], maintaining a reputation for absolute dedication to their contracts and the Emperor. This perceived loyalty has earned them immense trust over centuries, even as they operate with a mercenary focus on results and wealth. Despite their reputation for being reliable advisors, rumors persist regarding their involvement in assassinations and more aggressive tactics. While they are not typically suited for direct combat compared to other [[Guilds]], they maintain vast resources, including fleets of ships and specialized vessels like the [[Bastion's Shadow]]. [[The Guild]] has recently experienced significant growth, with many of its chapters expanding rapidly across the world.}}

== Of Shadow and Sea ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[The Consultant]]'s [[Guild]] is a professional organization that maintains archives and accepts commissions from various clients. Represented by a crest featuring a simple pair of gardening [[shears]], the group receives intelligence relayed through [[Masons]]. During an investigation into client suspicions at [[75 Hanberry Street]], members of the guild began to earn [[Shera]]'s growing favor. Looking toward the future, [[Lucan]] expresses a desire to steer the direction of the group.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">7</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|The [[Consultant's Guild|Consultant’s Guild]] maintains archives.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c2">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 2</ref>}}</li>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Shera]] is starting to like the [[Consultant's Guild]].<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c3" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|The crest of the [[Consultant's Guild|Consultant’s Guild]] is a simple pair of gardening [[shears]].<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c4">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 4</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|The [[Consultant's Guild]] receives information relayed by [[Masons]].<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c6">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|The [[Consultant's Guild|Consultant’s Guild]] is a group that [[Lucan]] hopes to steer.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c14">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 14</ref>}}</li>

== Of Dawn and Darkness ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[The Consultant]]’s [[Guild]] is an organization recognized as one of the groups capable of swaying public opinion. Described as the most loyal guild within [[The Empire|the Empire]], the group manages client issues with great efficiency and works to eliminate threats to those under their protection. As tensions rise, [[Calder]] weighs the possibility of launching an attack against them and eventually addresses the guild directly. During these conflicts, [[Kelarac]] urges [[Calder]] and his allies to cut through the organization.}}

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[The Consultant]]’s [[Guild]] employs workers within the fish warehouses and [[Rainworth docks]], operating under a set of unspoken rules and specific laws regarding trespassing, assault, property [[destruction]], defiance of orders, and the divulgence of secrets. While [[Shera]] has served as Head, the organization has not appointed a new [[Blackwatch Guild Head|Guild Head]] for some time and is represented by [[Shera]] alongside three High [[Councilors]]. The group, which includes members such as [[Zhen of the Masons|Zhen]], specializes in observing client conversations, producing reports to identify [[Champions]], and providing experts for the redesign of security. Despite their influence dipping during the years of active [[Regents]], the [[Guild]] attempted to bribe the [[Champion]] and allowed [[The Empire|the Empire]] to rot for three years. Although members were among those left standing, there is growing concern that the [[Guild]] might be shut down, especially as [[Shera]] and [[Lucan]] were not firmly bound to the organization.}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Consultant's Guild|Consultant’s Guild]] provides experts to redesign and rebuild security.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c5">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 5</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Members of the [[Consultant's Guild|Consultant’s Guild]] were among those left standing.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c5" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Consultant's Guild|Consultant’s Guild]] is represented by [[Shera]] and three High [[Councilors]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
